goal: Interactive flywheel init in a repo with an existing flywheel.toml shows the current backend and source and offers to reconfigure, rewriting only the answered keys while preserving all other keys; declining leaves the file byte-identical and non-interactive runs never touch it.

references: .flywheel/specs/00024-FEATURE-interactive-init.md FR-9 -- at minimum [agent], [[defaults.graders]], and unanswered [paths] keys must survive a reconfigure
constraints: Declining the reconfigure prompt leaves flywheel.toml byte-identical; scaffold dirs are still ensured and init exits 0

Accepting rewrites only keys the prompts answered ([store] backend/schema, [source] kind and its source-specific keys); a hand-tuned [agent] model and [[defaults.graders]] entries must survive a round-trip -- add a test proving it (spec FR-9 acceptance)
A pre-[store]-era flywheel.toml gains the [store] section on reconfigure without disturbing other keys
Non-TTY or --defaults with an existing flywheel.toml keeps the never-touch behavior and 'exists: ... (left untouched)' reporting

Use stdlib only (tomllib reads, no new TOML-writing dependency); preserving the user's exact comments and formatting in untouched sections is required only to the extent the chosen rewrite approach allows, but key/value content must never be lost
Commit with a Conventional Commits message (feat:) before emitting intent=verify
non_goals: No migration tooling for old configs beyond the reconfigure path
No changes to the factory, worker, or TUI
edge_cases: flywheel.toml exists but is malformed TOML -> report the parse error and leave the file alone rather than crashing or overwriting
Reconfigure switching source kind from github to directory must drop repo/label keys from [source] (they are invalid for directory)
